notes: Raw station observations and gridded products must remain distinguishable.

name: NASA Panoply
capabilities: maps; contours; sections; time plots; projections; animation
notes: Strong projection and multidimensional view benchmark.

name: Copernicus MyOcean Pro
capabilities: 4-D maps; profiles; transects; series; histogram; export
notes: Benchmark for modes and export; not a package dependency.

name: NOAA Ferret/PyFerret
notes: Oceancube must keep analysis outside renderer.

name: ParaView
capabilities: surface; slice; isosurface; volume; flow; remote rendering

name: pyParaOcean
capabilities: ocean features; scalable analysis; Cinema database
notes: Validates renderer-neutral ocean filters and scale limits.

name: ggplot2
scientific_preparation: none unless layer stat explicitly requested

name: plotly
notes: Broader capability but conversion fidelity and dependency burden require explicit adapter.

name: gganimate
notes: Use gifski or av output backends only when installed.

name: rgl
notes: Best current R-native scientific scene candidate; headless/native constraints are blockers to core Import.

name: threejs
notes: Potential decorative or communication globe; scientific projection contract still required.

name: mapdeck
capabilities: large point line polygon layers; tiles
notes: Token and external tile coupling conflict with offline core.
